topic: Apple's second fall wave: 7+ more products land in October 2026
details: iPhone Duo was unveiled Sept 9 but doesn't ship until October, alongside up to 7 more products across Mac, iPad, TV and Home — but the most-hyped one, the touchscreen MacBook, may have just slipped to 2027 over a memory chip shortage.
